periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented downwards and outwards toward the lateral margins of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/teardrop shape with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with a distinct extension of the black pigment toward the inferior-medial quadrant of the orbital region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band at the lateral flank occupies approximately 25-30% of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the apex with no visible flattening or notches.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ventral inversion of the head; visible rufous-toned discoloration/staining across the white abdominal fur.
